title: How viable are plans to free up prison space in England and Wales?

paragraphs.en: Andy Burnham said on Monday he was “increasingly confident” that PC Andrew Harper’s killers would not be freed in the new year.
paragraphs.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）周一表示，他“越来越有信心”警察安德鲁·哈珀（Andrew Harper）的凶手不会在新年获得释放。

paragraphs.en: Determined to ensure that Albert Bowers and Jessie Cole, who were jailed for 13 years in 2020 for manslaughter, serve their full sentences, he has asked the justice secretary, Alex Norris, to examine three options for increasing prison capacity.
paragraphs.zh: 为了确保因过失杀人罪于2020年被判处13年监禁的阿尔伯特·鲍尔斯（Albert Bowers）和杰西·科尔（Jessie Cole）服满刑期，他已要求司法大臣亚历克斯·诺里斯（Alex Norris）研究三种提高监狱容量的方案。

paragraphs.en: The options outlined by Burnham are speeding up the deportation of foreign offenders, releasing female prisoners from jail and reviewing indefinite sentences given to “lower-risk” prisoners.
paragraphs.zh: 伯纳姆提出的方案包括：加快遣返外国罪犯、释放女囚、以及重新审查给“低风险”囚犯判处的无限期刑罚。

paragraphs.en: There were 10,134 foreign nationals held in prisons across England and Wales at the end of June 2026, according to the most recent Ministry of Justice figures.
paragraphs.zh: 根据司法部的最新数据，截至2026年6月底，英格兰和威尔士的监狱共关押着10134名外国人。

paragraphs.en: Removing them from the UK would therefore be a major political coup for Burnham.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，把他们驱逐出英国对伯纳姆来说将是一场重大的政治胜利。

paragraphs.en: Related: Burnham ‘increasingly confident’ PC Harper’s killers will not get early release
paragraphs.zh: 相关报道：伯纳姆对哈珀警官凶手不会提前获释“越来越有信心”

paragraphs.en: But there are several major obstacles.
Going back to Tony Blair, governments have pledged to clear jails of foreign prisoners, but all have failed.
paragraphs.zh: 从托尼·布莱尔时代起，历届政府都承诺要清除监狱里的外国囚犯，但全都失败了。
